features.title: Drives a real iPhone
features.what: Reads the screen and acts on a real iPhone or an iOS simulator through a local server.
features.evidence_quote: Poki uses your iPhone like you do

features.title: Your own MCP client
features.what: Runs as an MCP server inside Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client on your own subscription.
features.evidence_quote: Connect Poki MCP and use your own subscription.

features.title: Taps, types and scrolls
features.what: Sends taps, swipes, hardware keys and text to a simulator or a paired physical device.
features.evidence_quote: Send taps, swipes, hardware keys, and Unicode text across simulators and paired physical devices.

features.title: Remembers past tasks
features.what: Poki Agent keeps past tasks and runs the same job faster on repeat.
features.evidence_quote: Poki Agent remembers past tasks and runs them faster on repeat.

features.title: Two commands to start
features.what: Clone the repo, run the setup script, then start the server locally.

features.title: Controls the real phone
features.what: It acts on the real iPhone, so messages and payments go through if asked, and screen contents go to your model service.

features.title: Needs macOS and Xcode
features.what: Runs on macOS with full Xcode, Rust, Node and ffmpeg installed.
features.evidence_quote: Requires macOS 15 or later, full Xcode, Rust, Node.js 24+, and ffmpeg.

risks.text: acts on the real phone; screen contents go to the model service
